## Notes

Hourly schedule per risk category, unlocked by hiring a Warden; Lockup, Sleep, Eat, Yard, Shower, Free Time, and Work variants; regimes confine prisoners to areas rather than forcing actions; cooks start four hours before Eat; prisoners never sleep from 8 AM to 8 PM.
